payout_period_check.name: payout_period_check
payout_period_check.value: ("payout"."period_start" is null and "payout"."period_end" is null) or ("payout"."period_start" is not null and "payout"."period_end" is not null and "payout"."period_end" > "payout"."period_start")

ticket_type_seating_check.name: ticket_type_seating_check
ticket_type_seating_check.value: "ticket_type"."seating_type" in ('standing','seated','numbered','box') and "ticket_type"."max_per_order" between 1 and 1000 and "ticket_type"."people_per_unit" between 1 and 50 and ("ticket_type"."seating_type"='box' or "ticket_type"."people_per_unit"=1) and jsonb_typeof("ticket_type"."seat_rows")='array'

venue_coordinates_check.name: venue_coordinates_check
venue_coordinates_check.value: ("venue"."latitude" is null and "venue"."longitude" is null) or ("venue"."latitude" is not null and "venue"."longitude" is not null and "venue"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "venue"."longitude" between -180 and 180)
